schema.statement: GRAPH.CONSTRAINT CREATE tortoise_ge_uid UNIQUE NODE GraphEvent PROPERTIES 1 event_id

schema_note: ⚠️ Statement 2 records WHAT THE SCRIPT ISSUED, and the script was wrong: `tortoise_ge_uid` sat in the GRAPH-KEY slot of the module command, so the command addressed a graph it minted on the way (which carries no `event_id` index) — the `missing supporting exact-match index` is that graph failing its own precondition, NOT a server limit and NOT an asynchronous-index race. Correctly formed against the probe graph's own key the constraint is ACCEPTED (`PENDING`) on falkordb-server:v4.20.6. Fixed in the script after this run (see its module docstring and README §2); the statements and slopes below are unaffected — the constraint was refused in this run either way.
